respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture represents MakeMyTrip's Next-Gen Security Operations Center (SOC). It ingests security logs and telemetry from hybrid sources (AWS public cloud and On-Premises) into Apache Metron. Following Rule 5, the generic 'AWS' cloud source tile is mapped to the specific services named in the transcript (AWS CloudTrail and Amazon GuardDuty). On-premise sources feed into Apache Metron via Syslog/Kafka. Ingested data is persisted and processed by Amazon EMR into Amazon S3 (the Security Data Lake). Amazon Athena performs analytics and log mining on S3, and long-term profiles are fed back from S3 into Apache Metron to enrich incoming data. Alerts generated by Apache Metron flow into Blitz (SOAR), which presents enriched alerts to SOC analysts (Alerts / UserCompanyAnalyst), who can trigger mitigation actions such as blocking malicious sources via AWS WAF.
